narrative: Reports of potential U.S. military strikes on Iran set up safe-haven demand for the Sunday open, reinforcing the greenback's carry advantage — EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.0969, while USD/CAD finished at 1.4349. Elevated VIX levels and equity market liquidation from Friday's close likely to support safe-haven flows toward USD and CHF, while keeping risk-sensitive currencies under pressure for the Tokyo open. Traders look to Wednesday's U.S. PCE inflation data as the key macro catalyst before the Thanksgiving holiday.
